question: What is the standard weight of hammer for women in the hammer throw event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 kg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **4 kg** is the **standard weight of the hammer** for **women **in the** hammer throw event**.
 
• The hammer throw is a** track and field event** in which the athlete throws a heavy metal ball attached to a wire and handle.
 
• This event is part of the Olympic Games and Worl
